lines: Otter's free plan stops at 30 minutes.
Here's Lynkk versus Otter.ai, in under a minute.
Lynkk records up to 2 hours per recording, on every plan.
Otter lists six languages, one per conversation. Lynkk transcribes 17, four in beta, including Hindi.
On the Mac, nothing joins the call.
Lynkk notices it, records both sides, and labels your lines You.
After the call, a free Meeting Brief: decisions, open questions, and tasks with owners and due dates.
Send them to Jira from the note, one issue each.
Every answer cites the note, and plays the moment it was said.
Lynkk records the call, writes the brief, and hands your tasks to Jira.
